::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 6th [1883]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1883/ 2
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd)

Many thanks for [Delicia](other_books/otherbook_959.qmd), who is very pretty, and I shall be very glad of her when I can put her in.[^1]

I envy the spirit of the people who finished their Whitsuntide decorations before the early service.  I am thankful enough to get them all done on Saturday

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: A silurian envelope with a long flap for writing on, the outside addressed to Miss Carter Smith/ Thistleworth/ Stevenage and postmarked Winchester 6 June and Stevenage 7 June 1883.
[^2]: In fact *Delicia Darling: A Kentish Medley* did not appear in *MP*  until August 1886.
